_readme: THREE TIERS, TWO VENDORS. Volume falls at each stage, so cost per stage
stays roughly flat while capability rises.
poll  Gemini, free tier      ~8,760 calls/yr   reads every new item
vet   Claude Haiku 4.5       ~50-300 calls/yr  material or routine?
write Claude Opus 5          ~260 calls/yr     the article
Gemini sits at the poll stage precisely because that is the only stage with
enough volume for a free tier to matter. At hourly polling, paying per call
would cost more than the writing does.
IF GEMINI IS DOWN THE POLLER DOES NOT STOP. It falls back to deterministic
corroboration scoring - counting how many independent feeds carry the same
entity in a window - which needs no model at all. Degraded, not dead.
VERIFY THESE IDS BEFORE THE FIRST RUN. The Gemini ladder was wrong once
already: two of four IDs did not exist. Run the Setup check workflow.
